title: Battle of the Bay of Velez
text: The Battle of the Bay of Velez or the Battle of Velez was a naval battle between the forces of Salah Reis and a Portuguese flotilla in which the forces of Salah Reis emerged victorious, captured the Portuguese squadron and seized the Penon de Velez. The Portuguese fleet was commanded by Inácio Nunes Gato, who was also the official interpreter for John III.
